# Provared sample book (third-party test fixture)

`office-supplies.jsonl` and `office-supplies.expected.json` are copied unchanged from
[provared/provared](https://github.com/provared/provared), `samples/`, at commit
`18510e5a168a2a24013427e6199abf5cfe6fbb41`.

Copyright 2026 Pavel Izmaylov. The sample files are licensed under the Apache License 2.0
(https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0). The names and the keys in them are invented test material.

They are used here to test AMEP's import profile for Provared books against the format's own expected results.
